item.title: Sports Reads for Your Kids
item.description: Sports inspire, entertain, and connect us (much like books do)! If your young reader is a mini statistician, the next breakout star, or simply a lover of the game, I have some recommendations for you. The stories below range from comprehensive histories of a sport to fictional tales of triumph. No matter what game your kid follows, these books are a slam dunk! Or touchdown, goal, home run, triple axel, absolute winning move…

item.title: What to Give Kids After Percy Jackson
item.description: I have always described myself as a huge Classics-nerd. Now taking Latin and Ancient Greek classes throughout middle and high school may have contributed to that, but I also just loved the stories and mythology. I mean the word epic comes from the ancient Greeks and their epic poems! If your young reader (or you yourself!) devoured the Percy Jackson series, and all the Camp Half-Blood Chronicles, movies, shows, etc. then we think these books will be just the right thing to jump into next!
